descriptions.w3d_d26e_tile_16_to_565_801d7c94: Converts the block at (ox, oy) of a 16-bit source image into one big-endian RGB565 4x4 tile with 8-byte rows; clipped texels keep their bytes. The source pixel is unpacked to a stack colour (the alpha 255 is stored but unused), then re-encoded. Names are inferred from the original instructions.
